description: This file defines the MembershipMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface and is responsible for configuring menu items related to the 'membership' screen within the OrangeHRM admin module. It utilizes traits for module and screen helpers and overrides the screen to 'membership'.

classes.name: MembershipMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration logic for the 'membership' screen in the OrangeHRM admin module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'membership' and returns null. Implements the MenuConfigurator interface method.
